dbqueries.dbquery: INSERT INTO tp_todo (user_id, process_id, position_id, applicant_id, budget_item_id, current_step_id, step_isscheduled, user_responsible_for_scheduling, user_is_decision_maker, user_is_interviewer, interviewer_can_confirm, appointment_id, appointment_time, appointment_status_id, feedback_present, todo_type, due_date, date_created) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now())
SELECT position_status FROM tp_positions WHERE position_id=?

SELECT *,IF(SUM(is_authorized_to_move)>0,1,0) AS isAuthorizedToMove ,IF(SUM(is_responsible_for_scheduling)>0,1,0) AS isResponsibleForScheduling ,IF(SUM(attendee)>0,1,0) AS isInterviewer, (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) > 0 AND todo.position_step_id_to < ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM tp_applicant_selection_process_traits taspt WHERE todo.process_id=taspt.process_id AND todo.user_id = taspt.user_id )AS feedback FROM ( SELECT tal.process_id, tal.applicant_id, tal.position_id, tal.process_moved_date, tal.current_step_id, tal.position_step_id_to, tapp.appointment_id, tapp.appointment_from_date, tapp.appointment_status_id, tpsu.user_id, tpsu.is_responsible_for_scheduling, tps.position_step_isscheduled, tps.is_interviewer_can_confirm, tpsu.is_authorized_to_move, IF(tpaa.attendee_id=tpsu.user_id, 1, 0) AS attendee FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT process_id, applicant_id, position_id, process_moved_date, position_step_id_from, position_step_id_to, CASE WHEN position_step_id_to > ? THEN position_step_id_to ELSE position_step_id_from END AS current_step_id FROM ( SELECT tasp.process_id as process_id, tasp.applicant_id, tasp.position_id, tasp.position_step_id_from, tasp.position_step_id_to, tasp.process_moved_date FROM tp_applicant_selection_process tasp INNER JOIN (SELECT p1.applicant_id,p1.position_id,max(p1.process_id) AS maxprocessId FROM tp_applicant_selection_process p1 GROUP BY p1.applicant_id,p1.position_id) p2 ON (tasp.process_id = p2.maxprocessId) @@ ) AS tmp_process GROUP BY applicant_id, position_id ) AS tmp_process WHERE tmp_process.position_step_id_to!=? AND tmp_process.position_step_id_to!=? AND tmp_process.position_step_id_to!=? AND tmp_process.position_step_id_to!=? AND tmp_process.position_step_id_to!=? ) AS tal LEFT JOIN tp_appointments tapp ON (tal.applicant_id=tapp.applicant_id AND tal.current_step_id=tapp.position_step_id AND tapp.appointment_status_id!=? ) LEFT JOIN tp_appointment_attendees tpaa ON (tapp.appointment_id = tpaa.appointment_id) LEFT JOIN tp_users tua ON (tpaa.attendee_id=tua.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_step_users tpsu ON(tal.current_step_id=tpsu.position_step_id) ,tp_positions tpos, tp_position_steps tps WHERE tpos.position_id=tal.position_id AND position_status=? AND tal.current_step_id=tps.position_step_id ) AS todo
GROUP BY process_id, user_id

SELECT CASE WHEN traf.to_user_id IS NULL THEN traf.by_user_id ELSE traf.to_user_id END AS user_id, tp.position_id, traf.to_step_id AS current_step_id, traf.feedback_date AS date_created FROM tp_positions tp, ( select * from (SELECT traf.* FROM tp_requisition_approval_feedback traf LEFT JOIN tp_positions tpos ON (traf.position_id = tpos.position_id) WHERE tpos.position_status = ? ) t INNER JOIN (SELECT p1.position_id as position_id1,max(p1.feedback_id) as feedback_id1 from tp_requisition_approval_feedback p1 group by position_id1 ) t1 on (t1.feedback_id1 = t.feedback_id) )as traf WHERE tp.position_id = traf.position_id AND traf.to_step_id IS NOT NULL @@
SELECT budget_item_id, owner_id, user_id, date_created FROM tp_budget_items tbi WHERE status = ? @@
SELECT position_id, current_step_id, user_id, due_date FROM tp_todo WHERE todo_type = 0 AND due_date < ?
